lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: You'll know you're in dangerous territory when the canopy breaks and the light comes through. The creatures like the sunlit patches.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: Something about the warmth draws them out.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: Where the ferns grow, that's where they hunt.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: Avoid the bright spots in the jungle, is my advice.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: Beautiful as they are. The ferns practically glow in those clearings which, again, beautiful, but also a sign that something with teeth is probably nearby.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: The sunlit clearings aren't safe, no matter how inviting they look.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: If you see ferns and open light, assume you've just walked into something's territory.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: Stay outta the sun and you'll mostly be left alone.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: Step into the light? You'll have company very quickly, and it won't be social company.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: Bright patches in the jungle? Stay out. Dark sections further out near the rock formations with the mushrooms? Also stay out.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: The safe path is an extremely specific narrow strip. I recommend learning it quickly.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: The two types of bad territory are very different and also somehow equally bad.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: At least the Sons of Mars will tell you to leave before they do anything about it. The jungle things don't bother with that step.
